summary: Cango Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, reporting unaudited Q2 2026 financial results. The filing details quarterly performance, including revenue of US$50.8 million, a net loss of US$81.6 million primarily from non-cash impairments, and operational updates on Bitcoin mining and AI compute initiatives. No special-situation transaction is announced; this is a routine earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
